name: where-in-the-world
description: Track the Cort family's adventures around the globe

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:server
scripts.lint: npm run lint:client && npm run lint:server
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:client && npm run lint:fix:server
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check:client && npm run type-check:server
scripts.validate: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run test
